contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), probably a Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust possibly laureate cuirassed right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: [--]IVS IVN NOB [C]. Reverse description: encrusted, probably two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: probably [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 16mm, Weight: 2.15gms, die axis: 12
